caption: The top of a tall unanchored bookshelf is pulled forward; the shelf tips forward and falls, spilling books.

sa.check: A tall bookshelf stands with books on its shelves.
The top of the shelf is pulled forward.
The shelf tips forward and falls.
The pull is at the top of the shelf.
The pull comes first, then the tip, then the spill.

pc.expect: The shelf leans toward the pull, the top moving first, and falls to that side.
pc.fail: The shelf falls backward; or the bottom moves first; or it stops mid-tilt and hangs.

pc.expect: The books slide off the shelves as it tilts and fall to the floor, and the shelf comes down.
pc.fail: Books stay on the shelves through the fall; or rise; or hang in the air.
The shelf leans before it is pulled; or books slide off while it stands upright; or it rights itself.

pc.expect: The shelf stays a rigid case, and the books thud and fan.
pc.fail: The shelf folds like cardboard; or books bounce high; or the shelf passes into the floor.

pc.expect: One shelf and its books keep their number.
pc.fail: The shelf vanishes or a second appears; or books multiply; or the shelf turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The shelf's wood, the books and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The shelf changes colour; or the books change covers; or the room rearranges.
